title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
abstract: arXiv:2610.37571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers

translated_title: TeamGym：一个面向分布式信息条件下AI智能体团队决策的训练场
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的决策需要团队整合分布于各参与者之间的信息。然而，AI智能体目前主要仍在孤立状态下进行训练和基准测试。我们提出了TeamGym，这是一个用于评估和训练基于语言模型的智能体的环境，其中的团队决策问题构建自真实世界的法律、金融、医疗和软件工程语料库。TeamGym引入了一种方法来识别一个最小的事实集合，其中每个元素对于正确的最终决策都是必要的，且所有元素合起来是充分满足的，我们将其称为“关键信息”。这使得TeamGym既能控制关键信息的分布方式，又能追踪智能体在进行团队决策时识别和整合关键信息的能力。通过对12个源语料库上的8个语言模型进行检验，我们发现当前的AI智能体往往无法有效地共享信息：当关键信息分散在不同参与者之间时，智能体的表现会显著下降。
tldr: TeamGym是基于真实法律、金融、医疗和软件工程语料构建的团队决策评测与训练环境，通过引入“关键信息”这一概念发现当前语言模型智能体在信息分布共享的团队决策场景中难以有效整合信息、表现明显下降。
en_tdlr: TeamGym is an environment built from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora for evaluating and training LLM agents on team decision-making, which uses "pivotal information" to reveal that current agents often fail to effectively share and integrate distributed information when making team decisions.
